filename: denied-<monotonic sequence>.json; fresh exclusive file, coordinator sequence only
BudgetError_rule: Only actual imported shared_budget.BudgetError with type(code) is str and exact membership in reason_codes (budget subset). Never accept arbitrary exception.code/name or prefix/regex normalization. Unknown→UNCLASSIFIED.
WorkerError_rule: Only actual WorkerError; match one exact static string arg in map (type(arg) is str). Do not invoke str/repr on exceptions or log args. Dynamic messages/unmapped values→UNCLASSIFIED.
body_rule: Hash and UTF8 byte length of body_text ONLY if trusted authenticated /before payload makes a str available; no raw body/control envelope/header storage. Otherwise null/omitted. Do not parse model payload fields to create diagnostics capabilities.
ordering: Keep all existing guard checks, serialization, atomic reserve-before-permit, POSSIBLY_SENT, after_known and unknown/abort unchanged. Record exactly one diagnostic for each logical denied operation whether direct dispatch or Handler; Handler still403.
metrics_rule: Use already trusted inspect evidence or safely available sanitized prior known budget receipt snapshot only. No new ledger reads/RPC/money mutation for diagnostics; omit unknown values, never infer from key delta. Session remaining if derivable from complete allKNOWN previous session snapshot, otherwise omitted.
failure_rule: Malformed metric serialization/write failure cannot return permit, make valid payload bypass checks, clear inflight/blocked, settle, or replace original rejection with success. No fallback/retry/provider/price/cap change.
